turns.text: Why is there a "You are blocked for 24 hours" message in the on-generate token callback while hitting generate token API?

must_contain: The block is ABDM-1027 and arrives as an error object on /api/v3/hip/token/on-generate-token, while the generate token call still returned 202 Accepted
The request itself is not wrong, the number of requests is: the usual reasons are asking for a new token on every visit when the stored one is still good, or software that retries in a loop
A link token lasts six months: store it against the patient and reuse it, and request a new one only when it has expired
Stop every generate token call, wait for the 24 hours, and correct the cause before calling again
notes: NHA QA sample, 30 September 2026: 'Generated answer of its own out of generic information which doesn't align with the requirement of this question.' Verdict group: missing or thin knowledge. The rejected answer described rate limiting in general and not the situation: a token asked for on every visit, or a retry loop. The router gives this the how-do-i shape today: 'blocked' is not a failure word and the code is not in the question.
